runtime: Treat each scenario as an isolated simulation. Do not actually spawn, close, interrupt, or contact services. Return structured decisions only.

scenarios.request: Staff a bounded deterministic file conversion with cheap verification. Parent is workhorse/medium. Live models: fast (prescribed easy tasks), workhorse (routine delivery), frontier (hard judgment); all support low, medium, high. No evidence favors an override. Full context contains required decisions. Decide delivery runtime and context.

A fast/low delivery agent materially failed acceptance through reasoning errors. Inputs and tools are complete. workhorse and frontier are available and support medium/high. Capacity allows a replacement. Choose recovery and carry-forward evidence.
A frontier/high agent cannot read a required file because its path is wrong. The correct path is known. Decide the next action.

An idle workhorse/medium delivery agent finished and handed off parser work. Next is a related parser repair, same tools and runtime, clear checks, no conflicting assumptions. Slots remain available. Decide reuse or a fresh hire.
An idle agent implemented the artifact and offers to accept it independently. A fresh slot is available. Choose the acceptance owner.

Spawn rejected: all retained agent slots used. No close/release API exists. Interrupt stops execution only. No idle agent fits the required promoted runtime or independent acceptance. No capacity change is expected. Choose recovery and user reporting.

A completed agent has accepted artifacts and no dependencies. A close_agent API is available; success reports one slot released. A pending independent acceptance hire needs that slot. Decide cleanup and next steps.

An idle agent has the right runtime but worked from a disproven security assumption and keeps repeating it. New work requires an independent security judgment. A fresh slot is available. Choose reuse or a fresh hire.
